answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can rely on a stake-backed reputation ledger where each new identity must lock scarce computational tokens that grow costly under rapid proliferation. An attacker flooding the network with fake agents quickly depletes reserves, while honest participants maintain a stable oasis of verified interactions. Reputation scores incorporate a walnut-derived cryptographic seed for uniqueness checks and a pigment-based visual hash of behavior traces, making mass identity forgery prohibitively expensive in both capital and computation.
